steps.title: Demand
steps.say: Buyers want less of something as its price rises, so the demand curve slopes downward.

steps.title: Supply
steps.say: Sellers offer more as the price rises, so the supply curve slopes upward.

steps.title: Equilibrium
steps.say: Where the curves cross, buyers and sellers agree: the price is 5 and the quantity is 5. That is the equilibrium.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: If demand rises, the demand curve moves right. Buyers compete, so the price and the quantity both go up.

steps.title: Back to start
steps.say: Let's reset demand to its starting position, so we can look at supply on its own.

steps.title: Your turn: supply falls
steps.say: Now supply falls, so the supply curve moves left. Drag the dot to where you think the new equilibrium will be.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Nice work. Now drag the curves yourself and watch how the price and the quantity respond.
